claim.supported_scope: Deterministic SRMR, d_ULS, d_G, maximum-likelihood-function Chi-square, degrees of freedom, and NFI point estimates for saturated and estimated supported PLS or PLSc indicator-correlation models, plus an explicitly selected bounded adapted Bollen-Stine workflow with separate saturated and estimated null transformations, fixed indexed full-refit ledgers, Type-7 HI95 and HI99 bounds, and decisions for SRMR, d_ULS, and d_G.
claim.estimand: Observed-versus-model-implied indicator-correlation discrepancy and approximate fit for saturated and recursive estimated PLS correlation models, together with the empirical exact-fit distribution obtained after transforming the complete indicator sample to each fitted correlation matrix and fully refitting the same estimator on fixed case resamples.
assumptions: All indicators use the same finite complete cases and deterministic recipe order, and the recorded analytical sample size equals the source PLS result.
Observed and implied matrices are finite, symmetric, dimensionally identical correlation matrices; d_G and maximum-likelihood-function Chi-square additionally require positive definiteness.
The structural model is recursive and the model-implied matrices follow the stored composite, common-factor, or mixed measurement semantics.

Exact-fit inference requires raw observations, 999 to 10000 fixed draws, strict positive-definite observed and target correlations, and at least 90 percent usable values independently for each criterion.
exclusions: The bounded exact-fit v1 lane excludes generated interaction constructs, higher-order indicator expansion, covariance or correlation input, missing-data policies beyond model-wide listwise deletion, and unsupported/nonrecursive PLS structures.
RMS_theta, automatic universal fit decisions, and CB-SEM fit semantics are excluded.

This implementation is not full SmartPLS model-fit parity and is not release-qualified without full supported-shape breadth, independent full-refit oracle evidence, simulation calibration, real archive/export readback, packaged Windows qualification, performance evidence, and independent scientific review.
warnings: SRMR and NFI are approximate fit measures conditional on the specified model, estimator, indicator scaling, and data.
Raw d_ULS and d_G discrepancies do not establish exact fit without the separately requested adapted Bollen-Stine sampling distribution.
The present NumPy exact-fit reference validates transformation, ledger-summary, quantile, and decision primitives; it is not an independent PLS/PLSc full-refit pipeline.

equations.expression: d_G = 1/2 sum_k ln(phi_k)^2, where phi_k are eigenvalues of S^-1 Sigma_hat
Z_variant_star = Z S^-1/2 Sigma_variant^1/2, with sample_correlation(Z_variant_star) = Sigma_variant
HI_q = Type7({d_b: b usable}, q); not_rejected_q = (d_original <= HI_q), for q in {0.95, 0.99}

references.citation: Dijkstra and Henseler (2015), Consistent and asymptotically normal PLS estimators for linear structural equations, Computational Statistics and Data Analysis 81, equations 35-36, DOI 10.1016/j.csda.2014.07.008
Henseler et al. (2014), Common Beliefs and Reality About PLS: Comments on Ronkko and Evermann, DOI 10.1177/1094428114526928
Lohmoller (1989), Latent Variable Path Modeling with Partial Least Squares, Physica
Bentler and Bonett (1980), Significance Tests and Goodness of Fit in the Analysis of Covariance Structures, Psychological Bulletin 88(3)

simulations.design: Reflective, formative, and mixed recursive PLS and PLSc models across topology, sample size, loading or weight strength, distribution, misspecification, and positive-definite matrix condition.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed data-generation and scenario seeds with deterministic estimator settings.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every available criterion must match the preregistered independent reference tolerance and every scientifically undefined criterion must produce its typed unavailable reason.

simulations.design: Singular, near-singular, asymmetric, non-finite, dimension-mismatched, duplicate-indicator, underidentified, and tampered point-fit fixtures.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen deterministic adversarial matrices plus indexed near-boundary perturbations.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every invalid or unsupported case must fail or mark only the affected criterion unavailable, with zero fabricated fit values and complete semantic tamper rejection.

simulations.design: Pre-registered correctly specified and misspecified reflective, formative, mixed, PLS-PM, and PLSc populations across topology, sample size, distribution, missingness, matrix conditioning, seed, and worker count; saturated and estimated exact-fit runs are assessed separately.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed population, dataset, and exact-fit resample streams with failed fits retained in every denominator.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Monte Carlo proportions meet the frozen QualificationSpec V2 intervals and half-width policy, failed fits are included, and worker-count changes preserve every fixed ledger and decision.

boundaries.case: An observed or implied matrix is non-finite, asymmetric, dimension-mismatched, not a correlation matrix, singular, or numerically non-positive-definite.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Malformed matrices are rejected; a valid but singular correlation matrix leaves d_G, Chi-square, and dependent NFI unavailable with a typed reason and never a placeholder zero.

boundaries.case: The recipe explicitly requests the bounded adapted Bollen-Stine workflow with a supported raw-data PLS-PM or PLSc model and 999 to 10000 draws.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The engine performs two domain-separated null transformations and full-refit ledgers, emits exact-fit bounds and decisions separately from ordinary parameter bootstrap inference, and attributes pls_model_fit_exact_v1 in provenance.

boundaries.case: Exact-fit inference is not explicitly selected, the selector is malformed, a target matrix is not positive definite, or the recipe uses an unsupported data or model shape.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Ordinary runs do not claim exact-fit inference; malformed or unsupported explicit requests fail preflight or execution with a corrective typed diagnostic and never substitute ordinary bootstrap results.

boundaries.case: Indicators and all observed and implied matrices are permuted consistently.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Every point-fit criterion remains equal within tolerance after identity mapping.

boundaries.case: The same data, model, estimator output, and indicator order are assessed repeatedly across worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Matrices, criteria, method identity, and unavailable reasons are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: A sample size, indicator identity or order, matrix, convention, criterion, exact-fit method identity, operation, transformed-matrix witness, sample digest, ledger status, bound, tail probability, or decision is changed.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project or native validation rejects the payload rather than displaying or exporting it.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose PLS model-fit capability identity differs from pls_model_fit_v2.
Reject a fit or exact-fit block with a missing, unknown, legacy, substituted, or unlinked method version or provenance marker.
Reject a result whose recipe, run, or dataset fingerprint no longer identifies the source analytical cases.
Reject an archive whose fit matrices, transformation witnesses, sample or usable-index digests, ledgers, bounds, or decisions no longer match its integrity metadata.

Reject duplicate indicators, malformed matrices, non-finite values, inconsistent formulas, invalid reason codes, unknown fields, incomplete exact-fit ledgers, and recomputed summary or decision mismatches.
Keep pre-v2 SRMR and d_ULS readable as historical output without adding the v2 method identity or advanced criteria.

persistence.legacy_policy: Historical fit blocks remain immutable and readable; only exact pls_model_fit_v2 payloads satisfy this contract.

setup_controls: Supported PLS-PM or PLSc bootstrap recipe
result_surfaces: Saturated and estimated SRMR, d_ULS, d_G, Chi-square, df, and NFI
Separate saturated and estimated HI95 and HI99 exact-fit results
Complete partial or failed replicate ledger
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: GUI and CLI must preserve the same v2 identity, exact-fit v1 identity, sample size, indicator order, matrices, variant operations, fixed sample digests, ledgers, point criteria, bounds, decisions, unavailable reasons, seed, and worker-invariant analytical payload for identical inputs.
accessibility_rules: Every point-fit value, exact-fit bound, decision, usable count, and unavailable state appears in an accessible table.
No fit state, group, significance decision, or warning is communicated by color alone.
